name: Grand City Properties S.A.
summary: Grand City Properties S.A. engages in the residential real estate business in Germany, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It invests in, manages, and rents real estate properties in North Rhine-Westphalia and Berlin; and metropolitan regions of Dresden, Leipzig, and Halle. The company also engages in financing activities. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg. Grand City Properties S.A. is a subsidiary of Aroundtown SA.
